from rest_framework_simplejwt.serializers import TokenObtainPairSerializer
from rest_framework_simplejwt.views import TokenObtainPairView

class ScopedDeveloperTokenSerializer(TokenObtainPairSerializer):
    def validate(self, attrs):
        data = super().validate(attrs)
        requested_scopes = self.initial_data.get('scopes', [])
        # Intersect requested scopes with user's authorized scope set
        allowed_user_scopes = set(self.user.get_authorized_scopes())
        sanitized_scopes = list(set(requested_scopes).intersection(allowed_user_scopes))

        refresh = self.get_token(self.user)
        refresh['scopes'] = sanitized_scopes
        refresh.access_token['scopes'] = sanitized_scopes
        data['refresh'] = str(refresh)
        data['access'] = str(refresh.access_token)
        return data

class ScopedDeveloperTokenView(TokenObtainPairView):
    serializer_class = ScopedDeveloperTokenSerializer
